description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] and [HP Stock (3000)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Oracle of Light] and [Emissary of Light Mode] to the user

description.name: HP Stock (3000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 3000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Awoken Oracle of Light
description.text: Knight and Support abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Knight and Support abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies after using Knight and Support abilities

description.name: Emissary of Light Mode
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Ice 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Earth 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Wind 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Water 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Holy 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Dark 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Poison 10% (15s)] after another ally uses a Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison ability, removed after triggering three times
